usage: amd-smi set [-h] [-o PWR_TYPE WATTS | -L CLK_TYPE LIM_TYPE VALUE | -R STATUS]
                   [-g GPU [GPU ...]] [--json | --csv] [--file FILE] [--loglevel LEVEL]

AMD System Management Interface | Version: 26.2.2+97f5574fe2 | ROCm version: 7.2.4 | Platform: Linux Guest

If no GPU is specified, will select all GPUs on the system.                                    
A set argument must be provided; Multiple set arguments are accepted.                                    
Requires 'sudo' privileges.

Set Arguments:
  -h, --help                               show this help message and exit
  -o, --power-cap PWR_TYPE WATTS           Set either PPT0 or PPT1 power capacity limit:
                                           	Ex: `amd-smi set -o ppt0 1300`
                                           	PPT0 min cap: 0 W, PPT0 max cap: 750 W
                                           	PPT1 min cap: N/A, PPT1 max cap: N/A
  -L, --clk-limit CLK_TYPE LIM_TYPE VALUE  Sets the sclk (aka gfxclk) or mclk minimum and maximum frequencies. 
                                           	ex: amd-smi set -L (sclk | mclk) (min | max) value
  -R, --process-isolation STATUS           Enable or disable the GPU process isolation on a per partition basis:
                                               0 for disable and 1 for enable.

Device Arguments:
  -g, --gpu GPU [GPU ...]                  Select a GPU ID, BDF, or UUID from the possible choices:
                                           ID: 0 | BDF: 0000:fd:00.0 | UUID: 59ff74b5-0000-1000-804a-fe08e1ab3ae6
                                           ID: 1 | BDF: 0000:ff:00.0 | UUID: 25ff74b5-0000-1000-80a5-94c05f2eb594
                                             all | Selects all devices

Command Modifiers:
  --json                                   Displays output in JSON format
  --csv                                    Displays output in CSV format
  --file FILE                              Saves output into a file on the provided path
  --loglevel LEVEL                         Set the logging level from the possible choices:
                                               DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL
